shop.name: Muse Demo Jewellery
shop.delivery: Bangkok same day by courier for 3 USD; the rest of Thailand in 1 to 2 days for 2 USD; free on orders over 200 USD.
shop.payment: Bank transfer to Muse Demo Co. (the account number is sent when an order is placed) or cash on delivery in Bangkok. After a transfer, the customer sends the slip and the owner confirms.

items.name: Plain Silver Band
items.description: A plain sterling silver band with a softly worn finish, sizes 5 to 10.

items.name: Ruby Dome Ring
items.description: An 18K yellow gold ring with one large cabochon ruby.

items.name: Sapphire Halo Ring

items.name: Solitaire Diamond Ring
